name: sonor-remotes-mobile
description: Remotes phone app: the same page, talking to AV kit directly over TCP.

scripts.www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R ../public/. www/
scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
